sar.narrative: Customer C01569, holder of card C01569-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-08 03:00 and 2016-12-08 03:07, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,600.20 were made on the card online from device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.3.0 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2048x1536': $400.02 (3524117, 2016-12-08 03:00), $400.02 (3524126, 2016-12-08 03:05), $400.09 (3524132, 2016-12-08 03:07), $400.07 (3524133, 2016-12-08 03:07). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. When contacted, the cardholder stated they did not make the transactions and still holds the card. The activity is suspicious because: 4 online purchases within 6 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($400.02, $400.02, $400.09, $400.07; total $1,600.20). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-4124, CC-3841, CC-4086. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placed linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.

stop_reason: The requested verification settled it: the cardholder denied the activity, raising the probability to 0.98. Further graph steps would not change the actions (policy 6).
